observations: Sigma brand name visible on the lens barrel.
Focal length markings 12, 15, 17, 20, 24 visible on the zoom ring.
Full model designation '12-24mm 1:4.5-5.6 II DG HSM' visible on the front ring.
Serial number 1016378 printed on the barrel.
Gold ring detail near the front element.
Rear lens cap is attached, obscuring the mount type.

claims.evidence: The rear mount is covered by a cap in all photos; the specific mount (EF) cannot be confirmed.
Photos cannot demonstrate autofocus motors, aperture blade movement, or electronic communication.

risks.risk: Internal fungus, haze, or deep scratches on rear element
risks.proof: A clear photo looking through the lens elements against a bright light source.

risks.risk: Autofocus (HSM) motor failure or aperture stickiness
risks.proof: A video showing the lens successfully focusing and the aperture blades snapping shut/opening on a camera.

risks.risk: Incompatible mount (e.g., Nikon or Sony instead of Canon)
risks.proof: A photo of the rear of the lens with the cap removed to show the mount and contacts.
risks.if_unproven: as the least valuable mount variant

proof_requests: Photo of the rear mount with the cap off to confirm it is for Canon EF.
Photo looking through the glass against a light to check for fungus.
Short video of the lens autofocusing on a camera body.
response.reason: The specific model (Version II) is clearly identified from the text on the lens. It can be priced at its worst-case value (non-functional/damaged) until functional proof is provided.
